snippet.title: Gundemonium Collection
snippet.description:
Gundemonium Collection for the PS3 and PC. Gundemonium Recollection (0:00-3:10), GundeadliGne (3:12-7:47), and Hitogata Happa (7:48-10:33). Gameplay from all three games in the collection. 

Gundemonium Collection is a series of Doujin PC games made by Platine Dispositif. The games are localized and brought to North America by Rocking Android for the PS3 (PlayStation Network) and on Windows. These are very well made Doujin SHMUPS and well worth checking out if you like the genre.
